role: sole quality-ledger owner for second-round consolidation

summary.dedupe_rule: Merge repeated behavior or root cause across helpers; retain distinct failure modes, partial evidence, refutations, and scope boundaries.
summary.baseline_interpretation: Focused baseline is green but incomplete. It is not F-22 closure evidence.

canonical_findings.title: Trusted context and spec checks can accept archived governance as live authority
canonical_findings.root_cause: Archive-first lookup and fallback are not constrained to canonical .afol/adm authority.
behaviors: Trusted context may select docs/arc content.
Spec compatibility may accept archive-only content.

canonical_findings.title: Normal session creation accepts fictitious governance bindings
canonical_findings.root_cause: The normal new path uses a presence-only governance resolver instead of authoritative catalog validation.
behaviors: Nonempty feature/spec strings are reported as governed.
A session can be created for nonexistent authority.

canonical_findings.title: Authorization context is not enforced through every mutating front door
canonical_findings.root_cause: Approval metadata is descriptive and resolved context is dropped for several mutating command groups; adapter has no gate.
behaviors: Restricted callers can reach ADM/spec/ADR/changelog/state/hydrate paths.
Restricted adapter writes are not centrally denied.

canonical_findings.title: Materialized task and evidence loss can validate as fresh
canonical_findings.root_cause: Freshness compares source hashes without proving that canonical task and evidence projections still exist.
behaviors: Deleted materialized rows can leave validation current.
Trusted context can consume an incomplete projection.

canonical_findings.title: Restricted file mutation can disclose secret-bearing text
canonical_findings.root_cause: Protected-path policy excludes secret-like files and runs after the target can be read for preview, backup, or journal output.
behaviors: Dry-run diff can expose .env-like content.
Real writes can persist raw content in backups and mutation journal rows.

canonical_findings.title: Operation authority is self-attested and defaults to trusted local
canonical_findings.root_cause: Caller flags and environment values select trust without a non-forgeable launcher capability.
behaviors: An agent can omit or falsify the marker.
Trusted-only mutation and shell capability can become reachable.

canonical_findings.title: Generic file mutation can target AFOL control-plane state
canonical_findings.root_cause: The protected-path list does not classify .afol/wb, .afol/adm, .afol/state, or mutation journals as internal resources.
behaviors: File mutation can falsify governance, workbench, state, evidence, or journal data.
A later reader may fail closed only after corruption exists.

canonical_findings.title: Agent-facing tools catalog is semantically stale
canonical_findings.root_cause: tools.json is hash-managed but not generated from live registry semantics.
behaviors: Retired forms remain advertised.
Live transition and governance metadata are missing.

canonical_findings.title: Spec-gate close and ADR supersede contracts are incomplete
canonical_findings.root_cause: Decision authority, close-time conflict checks, and ADR replacement validation/syntax are not one enforced contract.
behaviors: Close does not consult unresolved spec-gate conflicts.
ADR supersede does not require the specified --by form or an existing acceptable replacement.
canonical_findings.scope: F22-C02B+C03 or owning feature; broad C06 remains unapproved

canonical_findings.title: Malformed spec-gate state can overwrite decision history
canonical_findings.root_cause: Malformed persistent state is treated as empty before a new result is saved.
behaviors: Corruption is not surfaced as a typed failure.
A later check or waiver can replace prior history.

canonical_findings.title: JSON error handling is inconsistent at command boundaries
canonical_findings.root_cause: Envelope helpers exist but command catches and early root errors still emit plain stderr or duplicate top-level data.
behaviors: JSON callers can receive no parseable result.
Errors differ between helpers and front doors.

canonical_findings.title: Pending-spec documentation contradicts session-scoped runtime behavior
canonical_findings.root_cause: Docs describe a global new-session block while the active contract blocks only the affected session start.
behaviors: AGENTS.md, README.md, and runtime reference overstate the gate.
Existing lifecycle test supports the session-scoped behavior.
canonical_findings.scope: Docs decision; no product implementation in this lane

canonical_findings.title: SQLite versioning and migration behavior is an unapproved design debt
canonical_findings.root_cause: The v1 database has no migration ledger or schema version, but the current contract explicitly defers broader State DB v2 materialization.
behaviors: Fresh v1 setup works.
Upgrade, downgrade, and recovery behavior is unspecified.

canonical_findings.title: Shared files index rebuilds too broadly and can publish stale state
canonical_findings.root_cause: Lifecycle transitions rebuild a shared full-tree index without incremental generations or stale-publish protection.
behaviors: Small transitions rescan the project.
An older cross-session scan can overwrite a newer result and still appear fresh.
canonical_findings.scope: F22-C07, with C04 dependency if persistence semantics expand

canonical_findings.title: Shared event streams lack one durable writer and strict reader behavior
canonical_findings.root_cause: Telemetry and workbench event paths do not share a global sequence/durability boundary and disagree on malformed input.
behaviors: Cross-session ordering and crash durability are unproven.
One reader throws while another silently projects incomplete state.

canonical_findings.title: Non-shell command parsing loses Windows backslashes
canonical_findings.root_cause: The parser treats every backslash as an escape instead of preserving structured argv values.
behaviors: C:\tmp\foo becomes C:tmpfoo.
Windows/WSL portability is not covered by the current Linux suite.

canonical_findings.title: Bootstrap snapshots copy the whole target instead of touched paths
canonical_findings.root_cause: Rollback snapshots recursively copy the complete target without a touched-path manifest.
behaviors: .git, node_modules, and untouched assets add snapshot I/O.
Fault rollback is correct only for the measured single-process path.

canonical_findings.title: Workbench publication can expose torn indexes and partial sessions
canonical_findings.root_cause: Index writes and initial workstream creation lack a staged promote/atomic read boundary.
behaviors: Readers can observe a transient incomplete index.
A failure during initial artifact writes can leave a partial session.

canonical_findings.title: Governance resolution and lifecycle start have a lock-domain TOCTOU
canonical_findings.root_cause: Pending-spec state is checked under a different coordination boundary from the session mutation.
behaviors: Start can commit against stale governance state.
Concurrent resolution can race with plan/task rewrites.

canonical_findings.title: Done can authorize an execution result from the wrong attempt
canonical_findings.root_cause: External verification runs outside the session lock and completion re-reads mutable attempt state.
behaviors: A restart during execution can attach an old result to the current attempt.
Done may be authorized without an execution token or fingerprint check.

canonical_findings.title: Mutation journal lacks explicit recovery and durable append boundaries
canonical_findings.root_cause: Prepared records fail closed but have no governed recovery path, and append returns without fsync guarantees.
behaviors: A crash after prepared can block normal reads/undo indefinitely.
Power loss can separate mutation state from journal state.

canonical_findings.title: Mutation backup paths and radar projections can lose undo/state semantics
canonical_findings.root_cause: Durable mutation records are not represented with relocatable backup identity and complete inverse projection semantics.
behaviors: Moving a repository can break undo through absolute backup paths.
Committed/noop/undo records can be projected incorrectly.

canonical_findings.title: Actor ownership and session selection are not consistently enforced
canonical_findings.root_cause: Mutation checks lack actor/lease binding and several readers bypass the canonical session resolver.
behaviors: A trusted actor can mutate another actor's task.
Restricted callers can fall back to a global active session.
Status/state/catchup can ignore context or AFOL_SESSION.

canonical_findings.title: Adapter configuration and provider artifacts are not transactional
canonical_findings.root_cause: Malformed config is overwritten and config/artifact writes are unlocked, ordered unsafely, and non-atomic.
behaviors: Corrupt config can be treated as enabled and replaced.
A failure between config and artifact writes can leave split state.
canonical_findings.scope: C01 for authorization gate; C06/owning feature for transaction hardening

canonical_findings.title: Memory corruption and concurrent updates are not fail-closed
canonical_findings.root_cause: Malformed memory is treated as missing and read-modify-write has no lock or content-hash CAS.
behaviors: Corrupt content can be overwritten.
Concurrent additions can lose data.

canonical_findings.title: Library corruption and concurrent topic updates are not fail-closed
canonical_findings.root_cause: Topic writes lack per-topic lock/CAS and index rebuild filters corrupt topics out.
behaviors: A corrupt topic can disappear from the rebuilt index.
Concurrent claims can be lost.

canonical_findings.title: ADR allocation and changelog writes have unlocked concurrency windows
canonical_findings.root_cause: Independent creators/read-modify-writers do not reserve or CAS shared domain state.
behaviors: Concurrent ADR creators can collide on an id.
Concurrent changelog entries can overwrite each other.

canonical_findings.title: External lock scope is host-local without explicit takeover semantics
canonical_findings.root_cause: Lock files live in host-local temporary namespaces and foreign hosts are never reclaimed.
behaviors: WSL/Windows or separate hosts do not share the lock namespace.
A foreign lock times out without an explicit coordination contract.

canonical_findings.title: Shell command text can be persisted without secret redaction
canonical_findings.root_cause: Evidence and workbench event persistence stores caller-provided command text verbatim.
behaviors: Literal credentials in test command text can remain in .evidence.jsonl and events.
Post-fact scanning does not prevent the write.

scope_decisions.reason: Security identifies these as immediate authorization/protected-resource blockers. No implementation is authorized in this lane.
scope_decisions.stop_condition: Stop after red tests if the trusted launcher/capability contract remains undefined.

scope_decisions.reason: Context authority and tools parity share registry/context boundaries but must not edit registry/router concurrently with C01.
Session creation, close, start, evidence, and execution attempts share lifecycle authority and locks.
scope_decisions.excluded: F-18 command-error delivery remains out of scope unless separately approved.

scope_decisions.reason: State DB v2, event durability, and broad journal materialization conflict with the current v1/future boundary without migration and recovery policy.

scope_decisions.decision: defer until core authority is trustworthy
scope_decisions.reason: Actor, lease, session fallback, and cross-host takeover semantics depend on C01 and C02B+C03 contracts.

scope_decisions.decision: route by owning feature unless a named F-22 clause proves the gap
scope_decisions.reason: Broad ADM/ADR/changelog/adapter/memory/library work is an overreach as one F-22 child slice. Adapter authorization alone remains in C01.

scope_decisions.decision: split measured hardening from deferred portability
scope_decisions.reason: Index cost, bootstrap scope, Windows argv, and portability need measured fixtures or an explicit runner; envelope work can follow the action contract.

scope_decisions.decision: keep as drift evidence, not implementation scope
scope_decisions.reason: The runtime behavior is covered and the documentation contradiction needs an owner decision before a docs edit.

smallest_test_first_slice.objective: Produce minimal red proof for restricted authorization and protected-resource boundaries before any builder receives a write slice.
focused_tests: R-02 restricted ADR/front-door denial; extend the same oracle across changelog, state, and adapter only after route scope is accepted.
SEC-001 restricted dry-run and real-write secret-path denial before target read/preview/backup/journal.
SEC-004 protected-path denial for .afol/wb, .afol/adm, .afol/state, and mutation journal targets.
SEC-002 direct restricted invocation must not become trusted without a launcher-issued capability; stop for authority design if the issuer contract is undefined.
not_first: broad runtime performance and cross-host tests
smallest_test_first_slice.handoff: After these red tests and the authority decision, transfer to the approved C01 builder; otherwise continue evidence-only.

proposed_test_first_order.gate: red proof plus explicit trusted-launcher decision
canonical .afol/adm authority and catalog scope decision
serialized governance/lifecycle child spec and compatibility decision
run only after each scope, migration, benchmark, or cross-platform decision is recorded

confidence_notes: Claim-level source review and focused runtime evidence are strong for confirmed items. Overall confidence remains MEDIUM because the full suite, release/security gates, mutation score, cross-process fixtures, and several intended-scope decisions are absent.

validation.method: jq schema/readback on every input artifact, consolidated output, and every JSONL ledger row; bounded git status; no full logs
